newsitem.title: USA: BRE Properties files $300 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: BRE Properties files $300 mln shelf.

text.p: BRE Properties Inc said Thursday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $300 million in debt securities, preferred and common stocks and warrants.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include the acquisition of properties or interests as suitable opportunities arise, the expansion and improvement of certain properties in the portfolio and repayment of certain indebtedness.

BRE, based in San Francisco, Calif., a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust which owns and operates apartment communities andother income producing properties in the western United States.
